legenda_post: I gave Claude Opus 5.5 one prompt: make a 20-second video about anything, your call; make it crazy. It picked a single photon.  The photon is born in the Sun's core and bounces around for up to 170,000 years before it gets out. Then it takes 8 min 19 s to reach Earth, passing https://t.co/VjdCqvJtQz
